core_step: Write INDEX/MATCH formulas into H12:L17 on the Task sheet to pull 'Exports' by series code and year

core_step: Write INDEX/MATCH formulas into H19:L24 on the Task sheet to pull 'Imports' by series code and year

core_step: Write INDEX/MATCH formulas into H26:L31 on the Task sheet to pull 'GDP' by series code and year
